fuel_consumption.source_quote: Based on our annual fuel consumption, a hypothetical 10% increase in the average price per gallon of aircraft fuel would have increased into-plane aircraft fuel cost for 2021 by $91.4 million.

instrument_type_details.notes: States 'do not currently hold any derivative financial instruments'. No fuel derivative activity since 2015.

throughput.source_quote: Fuel gallons consumed (thousands) 435,174 [2021] 289,401 [2020] 50.4% [from 2021 Annual Report operating statistics table, in thousands]; Aircraft fuel expense increased by 191.1% from $314.0 million in 2020 to $914.6 million in 2021 due to 50.4% increase in fuel gallons consumed.
